summary: The Interstellar Apple (La manzana interestelar) is a space-themed arcade video game created in Microsoft MakeCode Arcade. The player controls an apple wearing a space suit that must survive a journey through space by dodging black holes, avoiding meteors that fall from the top of the screen, and escaping from aliens that constantly chase it. Each time the player completes a level, the game becomes harder: more black holes, more meteors and more aliens appear. Touching an obstacle or an enemy costs one life. Our goal was to create a fun and simple way for kids to get curious about space and the dangers that exist beyond Earth, such as black holes and meteors. Building the game also helped us learn the basics of programming, game design and logical thinking.
details:
What it does and how it works. The game has four main elements:

  1. The main character: an apple in a space suit, controlled by the player, that moves around the screen to survive.
  2. Aliens (enemies): they chase the player, and each time they catch the apple, it loses one life.
  3. Black holes (obstacles): they appear in every level, and their number grows as the player advances. Crashing into one costs a life.
  4. Meteors: they fall from the top of the screen, and more of them appear with every level completed.

Benefits and intended impact. The game introduces young players to space concepts like black holes and meteors in a playful way, and it shows that kids can create their own games instead of only playing them.

Tools used. Microsoft MakeCode Arcade (block-based programming) to build the game, its pixel-art characters and its levels, and Canva to create the presentation.

Creativity. We chose an unexpected hero, an apple in a space suit, to make the game funny and memorable, and we designed our own pixel-art characters: the apple, the alien, the black hole and the meteor.

Factors we considered. Making the difficulty increase gradually so the game stays challenging, balancing the number of enemies and obstacles, and keeping the rules simple so anyone can play.
